what: Each letter sits transparent and skewed (skewY 32° · skewX 40° · .8 scale, bottom-left 24·32px), then on entering the view it stands up in order from the first letter at .03s intervals over .8s power2.out — an English title that unfolds like paper twisted upright.

options.on: view (when entering the screen, default) · load (as soon as it opens) · manual (the consumer calls el.fxPlay())
